The '''ongun-nur''' were large [[Bird/Legends|bird]] creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Despite their great, intimidating size, the ongun-nur were generally timid creatures. They usually traveled in large flocks. They had yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], pointed beaks, and their bodies were large, but mostly filled with air.<ref name="AS" />

The ongun-nur had very thin wings, and were unable to fly against the wind. They instead went wherever the wind took them.<ref name="AS" />
